subject: general
question:
The pie chart given below shows the number of trucks manufactured by six companies in a year. Total trucks manufactured by all these six companies are 1440. Number of trucks manufactured by a particular company is shown in terms of degree with respect to the total number of trucks manufactured by all these six companies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1442a4f5915be3df6b2af65276973cf9f27a82ad62ece78dfc1309db1bc8793.png] 

What is difference between the average number of trucks manufactured by K and P and the average number of trucks manufactured by J and M?
solution:
**Given:**

The total trucks manufactured by all six companies are = 1440

The manufactured by K = 108° 

The manufactured by P = 45° 

The manufactured by J = 55° 

The manufactured by M = 18° 

**Concept:**

They have divided production in degree = 360° = 1440

**Formula used:**

{Average} = {The sum of all the items over Total number of items}

**Calculation:**

Let the difference between the average of their production is X

The truck manufactured by K = {108over 360} times 1440 = 432

The truck manufactured by P = {45over 360}times 1440 = 180

The truck manufactured by J = {55over 360}times 1440 = 220

The truck manufactured by M = {18over 360}times 1440 = 72

The average of production of K and P = {432+180over 2}=306

The average of production of J and M = {220+72over 2}=146

The required difference X = 306 - 146 = 160 

**∴ The required result will be 160.**
